notes.title: King Randall's Party 1.21 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug which prevented levels from loading when the users machine was using non-period decimal separators.

notes.title: 1.2 and Full Release
notes.notes:
So KRP has been in Early Access for a little over two months now, and has seen a bunch of bug fixes, and the addition of a challenge mode which allows you to see how many waves you can survive through on some of the campaign maps. Some of theses were issues or features I had discovered/decided on my own, but a lot were generated by the folks who bought the game, so big shout out to you folks. :)

Given that there haven't been any other requests and I'm pretty happy with where the game is, I'm going to set it up as full release and let it into the wild.

notes.title: King Randall's Party 1.11 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug which prevented level's 4 and 15 from loading. Was introduced in the challenge mode update.

notes.title: Early Access Update 1
notes.notes:
Hey all! I was expecting to be out of early access in the end of December, but it looks like I'll be delaying a bit. I expect to push an update later this week or early next week which includes a new game mode (challenge mode with infinite waves), a bunch of bug fixes, and some new features as requested like a wave indicator. 

I'm also going about the process of adding an Australian Dollar price, which was missing so that our friends from Australia can buy the game on Steam. 

That's it for now, I'll be back once the patch is ready to go.
